# An induction handbook with fewer pages

Removed duplicate instructions after the supported practice trial. The remaining pages describe tasks, fallback choices and people who can help. The duty has not vanished with the older phrase compliance training. [[Volunteer handbook]] now reads like something usable at the desk. Keep the policy document linked for the rare questions it answers, rather than copying it into every explanation.
